title: Avoid caching partial index rows
description: Prevent BTree index scan projection pushdown from inserting sparse partial rows into the full-row cache.
constraints: Keep full-row cache hits and full-row cache writes intact
Preserve index scan filtering and limit behavior
convergence_criteria: Index scan writes to row_cache only when full row decoding was used
Streamed index scan tracks whether a row was read from storage and whether it is cacheable
A regression test proves projected index scans do not affect a later SELECT *
